summary.what_was_special: The delayed noun acts through a forceful transitive verb, so context repeatedly changed a nominal gloom into processes: deposition, corridor closure, capacity saturation, pursuit, entombment, and ethical exposure. Form-distant smoke, saffron, arrow, fitted-cover, and satiety branches were retained only where they produced a coherent anchored mechanism.
remaining_uncertainties: The two negative-face clauses may be intensifying material layers or synonymous parallel descriptions of one state.
The narrowing, hide, smoke, projectile, fitted-cover, and satiety branches may be analogical activators rather than live senses of the focus noun's exact form.
The action-to-mark moral recoil is reader-supplied; the following labels may identify bearers without stating causation.
The focus-only pronoun leaves its object unspecified; its facial antecedent becomes secure only when the adjacent context is admitted.
